response.sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(l.HGB) / AVG(l.HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM per_patient) SELECT pp.ID, pp.SEX, pp.avg_wbc, pp.ratio, pp.ratio - o.mean_ratio AS diff_from_mean FROM per_patient pp CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE pp.ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC, pp.ID LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The overall mean is the unweighted average of the per-patient ratios, taken over all patients with a non-null ratio. Patients whose AVG(HCT) is 0 or whose HGB or HCT are all missing give a NULL ratio (SQLite returns NULL for division by zero) and are excluded from the mean.
Ties in the difference are broken by patient ID, which the request does not specify.
